scope: eAP TRAIN40 out-of-fold head study plus one label-free Test12 candidate package (not submitted)

cv.scheme: five fixed 8-sequence blocks; train on four blocks, predict the fifth
cv.note: PHASE20 OOF fields were generated by rotations over the same five blocks; the head CV reuses that partition

geometry.frame_pool: union of (frame_timestamps_us[j], boxes_xyxy[j]) over rows of the same track whose row timestamp_us <= query timestamp_us
geometry.window_rule: frames with query_us - 600000 <= frame_us <= query_us (span <= 600 ms, inside the 650 ms causal budget)
geometry.duplicate_frames: same (track, frame_us) from several rows: first in (row timestamp, row order) wins; disagreements are counted and reported
geometry.box_size: w = x2 - x1 + 1, h = y2 - y1 + 1 (inclusive pixel boxes); s = sqrt(w*h)
geometry.slope: ordinary least squares slope k (1/s) of log(size) on time in seconds over window frames; sizes area-root, height, width
geometry.last2_slope: two most recent window frames only
geometry.phase_of_slope: phi = -log1p(-0.1*k), k clamped to [10*(1-2*exp(-1e-6)), 10*(1-exp(-8))] so phi in [MIN_PHASE, MAX_PHASE]
geometry.fewer_than_2_frames: k = 0 (phi = 0, T = +inf), n_frames field carries the count; the 2-frame row structure makes this impossible in train/test, the count is reported
geometry.truncation: box touches the border: x1 <= 0 or x2 >= 1279 (trunc_x) ; y1 <= 0 or y2 >= 719 (trunc_y); evaluated on the current (query) frame for the learned flags and on any window frame for the truncation-aware expert
learned_feature_vector_G: 100*rms residual of the log area-root fit (0 if n_frames<3)

non_learned_experts.GEO_TRUNC_AWARE: phi_height if any window frame trunc_x and none trunc_y; phi_width if trunc_y and not trunc_x; else phi_area

head_family.widths: 0.03*softplus(width_base + correction[1:]); width_base = rgb_width_logits when RGB fields are used, else 0
head_family.phase_field_scaling: released rule: PHASE20 fields 0:5 and 10:15 divided by 0.03
head_family.optimizer: AdamW lr 3e-4, wd 1e-3, betas (0.9,0.999), eps 1e-8, grad clip 1.0
head_family.updates_rule: U = ceil(2500 * N_train / 18422) (released exposure scaling; 12044 for 88744 rows)
head_family.batch: 128 rows uniform with replacement, torch.Generator seeded with the run seed

losses.GROUP: released fusion_loss: mean_batch(N * m_i * (|emit(loc)-y|/0.03 + 0.1*(pinball_0.1+pinball_0.9)/0.03)), m_i = 1/(G_train * n_group(i))
losses.BAND: same fusion_loss with m_i = w_band(i)/n_band(i), w = {c:0.5, s:0.3, l:0.1, n:0.1}, bands from target TTC (c (0,3], s (3,6], l (6,10], n (-10,0]); rows outside all bands get m_i = 0; band counts computed on the training fold only

GBM_REF.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=absolute_error, max_iter=300, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=200, early_stopping=False, random_state=seed) on target phase with BAND sample weights
GBM_REF.label: non-deployable reference

zero_learning_references.CONST_BEST: constant phase = band-mass-weighted median of training-fold target phases
zero_learning_references.RELEASED_IN_SAMPLE: released PHASE_ONLY_EVENT_S7_TRAIN40 checkpoint on its own 88744 training rows (in-sample, NOT OOF, not comparable)

metrics.overall: 0.5*MiDc + 0.3*MiDs + 0.1*MiDl + 0.1*MiDn, band means sample-weighted over finite MiD (official finite_mean)
metrics.official_scorer: E:/Garl-TTC/garl_ttc_benchmark/codabench/scoring_program/score.py, sha256 f3bbf089ba6e47edfce1de522c92ddc969db2260fac7544e82bc017fedf82dce, loaded through operational.garl_comparison.mid.load_scorer; the vectorized metric must agree to 1e-6 on every reported Overall
metrics.seed_aggregation: per seed Overall over all 88744 OOF rows; report mean and SD over seeds 7/13/21
metrics.paired_ci: Delta_i = mean_s MiD_i(variant,s) - mean_s MiD_i(REL,s); statistic sum_b w_b * sum_{i in b} Delta_i / n_b; 10000 paired resamples of the 40 sequences with replacement, numpy default_rng(20261118), percentile 95% interval; also per band

primary_candidate_rule.decided_on: eAP TRAIN40 OOF results only; never on Test12 or EvTTC
primary_candidate_rule.qualify: upper bound of the paired 95% CI of Delta Overall vs REL < 0
primary_candidate_rule.best: lowest seed-mean Overall MiD among qualified
primary_candidate_rule.ties: qualified variants with seed-mean Overall <= best + 1.0 MiD form the tie set; choose fewest inputs, then lowest seed-mean Overall
primary_candidate_rule.none_qualifies: primary = REL (released recipe refit); report that no variant qualified
primary_candidate_rule.final_fit: primary refit on all 88744 rows, seed 7, U = 12044

data_size_curve.subset_rule: within each fold, training sequences ordered by sha256(sequence_id + '|SIZE_CURVE'); first m kept
data_size_curve.role: descriptive only, not used for selection

leakage_checks.box_vs_target: Pearson and Spearman correlation of phi_area with target phase; median and band MiD of GEO_AREA; fraction of rows with GEO_AREA MiD < 10
leakage_checks.leak_alarm: median GEO_AREA MiD < 5 would indicate boxes carrying the label (near-exact projection); reported, not used to select
leakage_checks.causality_test: unit test: future frames never change features

test12.comparison_to_submitted: output disagreement only (MiD between prediction sets by submitted-prediction band, coverage, sign changes, failures |T|<0.1 or nonfinite must be 0); NOT accuracy
